Your settlement checklist

A calm starting plan for your first 30 days in Markham.

Keep the plan visible.
Enable a daily browser reminder. Your checklist stays on this device unless you choose to share it.
01 / UNDERSTAND

Language is a barrier, not a reason to stop. The plan begins with the person’s words, not a government form.

02 / ROUTE

Each task identifies the responsible organization—IRCC, Service Canada, ServiceOntario, CRA or a local Welcome Centre.

03 / FOLLOW THROUGH

Tick off actions, keep a one-week focus, and hand the plan to family or a community worker when needed.

Prototype only. Browser-local language detection is for this demo; production would use consent-based speech recognition, translation and verified service data. Urgent danger or medical emergencies: call 911.
